snippet.title: The Bunker Notes - Official Reveal Trailer | Dames 4 Games Halloween Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a look at the Reveal Trailer for The Bunker Notes, a horror adventure visual novel developed by Synthetic Domain. Players will embody a man who's prepped for a pandemic that wipes out huge swaths of the population. Explore the man's loneliness in an autonomous bunker in The Bunker Notes, coming soon to PC (Steam).
